wire.t: Nov 15: Drake Maye left Detroit's 35-10 win over New England in Munich in the first quarter with an ankle injury and did not return; Mike Vrabel said more tests are coming. Maye starts for Wild Goose Chase and finished with 3.02. New England is on bye in Week 11.
Nov 15: A.J. Brown was ruled out in the second half in Munich with a hamstring injury. He scored 4.7 in the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered lineup and Sleeper now lists him out.
Nov 15: Jahmyr Gibbs ran for 153 yards and two touchdowns and added 99 receiving yards in Munich (44.2 for Achane in the Membrane). Amon-Ra St. Brown caught two touchdowns (26.8 for Stroud of Turin).

Nov 15: The Chargers downgraded Ladd McConkey (back) from questionable to out for Monday night in Baltimore; he did not travel. He is still in the MY DAD IS DEAD lineup, and Justice Hill (BAL) is on the bench.
Nov 15: Sunday morning adds: ChuckJ10 picked up the Indianapolis defense for New Orleans and started it (13.0), and dcrabb added RB Zonovan Knight (1.9 on the bench).

Nov 14: Pudge247 added WR Chimere Dike and krunkdd added WR Elic Ayomanor on Saturday, both straight to the bench. rtmcruise added QB Jacoby Brissett, who Baltimore expects to start Monday night with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve.

Nov 15: Cincinnati led Pittsburgh 31-3 on Sunday night. Joe Burrow (31.16) and Tee Higgins start for Lead Nagger, Ja'Marr Chase (28.8) for Stroud of Turin, and DK Metcalf (0.0 so far) for Llamageddon.

stories.title: Bijan is your daddy beats the No. 1 team, Achane in the Membrane leads Lead Nagger by 4.84, and Ladd McConkey is out and still starting
stories.dek: FatMikeR wins with Cam Skattebo on the bench again, dstafford4254 benches 35.4 points in a 19.52-point hole, George Pickens scores 43.5 and might lose, and Stroud of Turin drops 177.34.
body: The 15.5-point underdog did it. Bijan is your daddy put up 128.50 and NjigbaR Please! sits at 108.98 with only the Cincinnati defense left. Deebo Samuel Sr. (28.54) and Stefon Diggs (20.3) carried FatMikeR, who did it with Cam Skattebo's 27.2 rotting on the bench for the second time in four days. On the other side, dstafford4254 started Kyren Williams (5.2) and Tetairoa McMillan (6.5) and benched Alvin Kamara (16.4) and Jordyn Tyson (19.0). Swap those two and NjigbaR Please! is ahead. The best team in the league is about to be 7-3 because it outsmarted itself.

The game of the night is Achane in the Membrane 167.14, Lead Nagger 162.30, with Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins and Germie Bernard still on the field Sunday night. George Pickens dropped 43.5, Emmett Johnson turned his first start into 35.1, and Pudge247 still trails because MakeItRains got 44.2 from Jahmyr Gibbs and 36.42 from Patrick Mahomes. The receipt: Pudge247 added Chimere Dike on Saturday and benched him. Dike scored 10.34. Germie Bernard, in the lineup, has 1.0. The gap is 4.84.

Stroud of Turin scored 177.34, the best number of the week, and buried Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (96.96) behind Chuba Hubbard (34.2), Ja'Marr Chase (28.8), Parker Washington (28.6) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (26.8). Lawrence of a Labia beat Nothing to see here 153.88 to 104.62 after Christian McCaffrey went for 48.3, so the commish is 7-3 and nobody can stop the commish from writing about it. Ivefallenandicantgetup leads Wild Goose Chase 99.44 to 89.82 with Br0phy out of players after Drake Maye left in the first quarter in Munich with an ankle injury.

Monday night still matters in one game. Llamageddon leads MY DAD IS DEAD 89.86 to 81.82, and Ladd McConkey is in the MY DAD IS DEAD lineup after the Chargers ruled him out Sunday afternoon. Justice Hill plays for Baltimore and is sitting on the OneSillyBannana bench. That is an 8.04-point game with a free swap available. If OneSillyBannana doesn't make it, this paper will print the zero in a very large font.

The Chargers downgraded Ladd McConkey (back) to out on Sunday and he did not travel. He is still in the lineup. Justice Hill (BAL) is on the bench and plays Monday. OneSillyBannana is down 8.04 with a free swap sitting right there. Make the move.

Elsewhere on Monday: rtmcruise has Zay Flowers (BAL) in the lineup and Jacoby Brissett, who Baltimore expects to start, on the bench. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered trails Stroud of Turin by 80.38, so this one is for pride only. krunkdd starts Quentin Johnston and the Baltimore defense and has Derrick Henry on the bench, up 9.62 on Wild Goose Chase. Lead Nagger has Omarion Hampton (LAC) on the bench.

The Week 10 payout is Highest-Scoring Receiver. George Pickens leads with 43.5 for Pudge247. The only starting receivers left are Zay Flowers and Quentin Johnston, and one of them needs a career night to get there.

stories.title: The Week 10 wire: MakeItRains spends $1 on a player who sat out, and Sunday morning belongs to ChuckJ10
stories.dek: Every claim and free-agent add from Weeks 9 and 10, kept apart from the trade talk.
body: Week 10 waivers (one claim): MakeItRains claimed Marvin Harrison Jr. for $1 and dropped Keon Coleman. Harrison was ruled out with a hamstring injury and spent Sunday on the Achane in the Membrane bench. Week 9 waivers: krunkdd paid $22 for Jakobi Meyers (dropped Chris Bell), Pudge247 paid $20 for Tank Dell (dropped Darius Cooper), ChuckJ10 paid $3 for Darren Waller (dropped Greg Dulcich) and $0 for J.J. McCarthy, krunkdd paid $2 for the Baltimore defense (dropped Philadelphia), dcrabb paid $2 for the Green Bay defense, and OneSillyBannana took Justice Hill (dropped Joe Milton) and Reggie Virgil (dropped Marvin Harrison Jr.) for $0, while RedDevil904 took Pat Freiermuth (dropped Jake Ferguson) for $0.

Week 10 free-agent adds: Bill_Buttlicker added Konata Mumpfield (dropped Gardner Minshew II), Fernando Mendoza and Tutu Atwell (dropped Drew Lock). OneSillyBannana added the Kansas City defense (dropped Chicago), added and then dropped TreVeyon Henderson, and added Tyler Higbee. Pudge247 added Pat Bryant and Chimere Dike, rtmcruise added Jacoby Brissett, krunkdd added Elic Ayomanor, and on Sunday morning ChuckJ10 swapped New Orleans for the Indianapolis defense and dcrabb added Zonovan Knight.

How it paid off on Sunday: ChuckJ10's Indianapolis defense scored 13.0 in the lineup, the best fantasy move Nothing to see here made all day in a 49.26-point loss. Tutu Atwell scored 4.1 in the Lawrence of a Labia flex and Konata Mumpfield scored 11.1 on the bench, so Bill_Buttlicker picked the wrong Ram and won by 49.26 anyway. Tyler Higbee scored 10.7 for MY DAD IS DEAD. Chimere Dike scored 10.34 and Elic Ayomanor 12.9, both on benches. Fernando Mendoza scored 13.92 on the Lawrence of a Labia bench.

FAAB spent so far, out of $200: Bijan is your daddy has spent $0, Lawrence of a Labia $9, Llamageddon $5, Wild Goose Chase $50 and Ivefallenandicantgetup $58. NjigbaR Please!, Breece'sBurdenDeflowered and MY DAD IS DEAD are all at $200 spent. FatMikeR has the whole bag and a bench that outscores most lineups.

stories.title: FatMikeR benches Cam Skattebo for two touchdowns and 27.2 points, and Bijan is your daddy still leads the league after Thursday
stories.dek: Washington beat the Giants 24-21. Bijan is your daddy has 41.06 on the board, Isaiah Likely put up 28.7 for Lead Nagger, and Antonio Williams scored 12.2 for ChuckJ10 a few hours after being cut.
body: Week 10 is on the board. Washington beat the New York Giants 24-21 on Thursday night when Jayden Daniels hit Stefon Diggs for a 32-yard touchdown with 57 seconds left. Five Fantasy Addicks teams scored on Thursday, and Bijan is your daddy leads the league with 41.06: Jayden Daniels 20.76 and Stefon Diggs 20.3. NjigbaR Please! had nobody playing and sits at 0.00 as a 15.5-point favorite.

Now the bad news for FatMikeR. Cam Skattebo scored 27.2 on the Bijan is your daddy bench with two touchdowns and 122 all-purpose yards on 21 touches. FatMikeR started Bijan Robinson and Zach Charbonnet at running back and left Skattebo sitting. To be fair, Skattebo missed Week 9 and caution is defensible, but the Giants coach said Wednesday he would be full go. Zach Charbonnet now needs 27.2 on Sunday to make that call look smart. Deebo Samuel Sr. is still in the lineup, and Sleeper now lists him as questionable.

ChuckJ10 had the weirdest Thursday in the league. He dropped Antonio Williams at 4:50 PM ET, a commissioner move put Williams back on Nothing to see here at 5:18 PM, and Williams caught a 31-yard touchdown for 12.2 points in the lineup. J.J. McCarthy added 18.12 and Malik Nabers 7.4, so Nothing to see here leads Lawrence of a Labia 37.72 to 0.00. Bill_Buttlicker is a 10.5-point favorite and has not scored a point yet, which is on brand. ChuckJ10 also benched Bucky Irving (bye) and filled the empty spot, dcrabb swapped in the Green Bay defense, and krunkdd filled both Ivefallenandicantgetup holes. Somebody reads this thing.

The receiver payout race is on. Isaiah Likely had nine catches for 127 yards and a 66-yard touchdown, 28.7 points in the Lead Nagger lineup, and leads Highest-Scoring Receiver by 8.4 over Stefon Diggs (20.3). Pudge247 leads Achane in the Membrane 28.7 to 0.00. OneSillyBannana leads Llamageddon 6.4 to 6.2 on Chig Okonkwo against Rachaad White. Everybody else plays Sunday.

columns.title: FORTY-THREE AND A HALF! GEORGE PICKENS PUT UP A NUMBER AND PUDGE247 MIGHT STILL LOSE BECAUSE OF A GUY ON HIS OWN BENCH!
columns.dek: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner has watched the Lead Nagger box score eleven times and it has not changed once.
body: I have been in press boxes since they had ashtrays in them, and I am telling you right now: GEORGE PICKENS SCORED 43.5 POINTS. FORTY. THREE. POINT. FIVE. That is the best receiver score in this league this week. That is a PAYCHECK. That is the Week 10 payout sitting in Pudge247's lap like a warm plate of nachos!

And Emmett Johnson! NINE WEEKS on the bench, finally gets the start, and drops 35.1! Joe Burrow throws in 31.16! Isaiah Likely put up 28.7 on THURSDAY! This team scored 162.30 and as of tonight it is LOSING. Do you understand me? LOSING!

Because MakeItRains rolled out Jahmyr Gibbs, and Gibbs went 44.2 with 252 yards from scrimmage, and Patrick Mahomes chipped in 36.42, and Achane in the Membrane is sitting on 167.14 like it OWNS the place. The gap is 4.84. FOUR. POINT. EIGHT. FOUR.

And here's the part that makes me want to throw my headset into the parking lot. Pudge247 added Chimere Dike on SATURDAY. Put him on the BENCH. Dike scored 10.34. Germie Bernard, IN THE LINEUP, has ONE POINT. One! I have scored one point in a pickup game at my age! You do not need a film room for this! You need a PULSE!

Burrow and Tee Higgins are still out there tonight, so maybe Pudge247 sneaks out of this. But if Lead Nagger loses by less than 9.34, I want every one of you to remember this column. I WANT IT LAMINATED!

columns.title: dstafford4254 had the answers on his own bench and benched them anyway. That's soft.
columns.dek: Dick Fitzwell on the No. 1 team losing to a 15.5-point underdog with 35.4 points sitting down.
body: I played linebacker. You know what we called a guy who had the right call in his pocket and didn't make it? Second string. NjigbaR Please! is 7-2, the best all-play record in the league at 65-34, and it is about to lose to Bijan is your daddy by double digits.

Here's the tape. Kyren Williams started and scored 5.2. Tetairoa McMillan started and scored 6.5. On the bench: Alvin Kamara with 16.4 and Jordyn Tyson with 19.0. That's 35.4 sitting next to the Gatorade and 11.7 on the field. The margin is 19.52 with only the Cincinnati defense left. Do the swap and you're ahead. No injury, no bye. Just a bad call.

Now the other side, because I'm fair. FatMikeR benched Cam Skattebo for the second time in four days. Skattebo had two touchdowns and 27.2 Thursday on the pine. And FatMikeR still won, because Deebo Samuel Sr. went for 28.54 and Stefon Diggs for 20.3. You know what that is? That's a team that wins ugly. I respect ugly.

Lesson: the lineup page is the practice field. You prepare there, so you don't get embarrassed on Sunday. dstafford4254, you're still the top dog. Act like it. Set the lineup like you're scared of losing, because today you should have been.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's seven Saturday lineup moves, ranked from smart to smartest
columns.dek: Oliver Klozoff has studied the Friday injury report from a lawn chair and has some extremely confident advice nobody should follow.
body: Saturday is for thinking. I have a cooler, a folding chair and the Week 10 injury report, and I have reached seven conclusions. Each one is better than the last, which is how you know they are good.

1. bench everyone listed as questionable. There are five of them in Fantasy Addicks lineups: A.J. Brown, Garrett Wilson, Kenneth Walker III, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jordan Addison. Questionable means the NFL has questions. You should never start a player who has questions. Start a player who has answers, like a kicker. 2. The Patriots and Lions kick off at 9:30 AM ET. That is before brunch. A football game before brunch does not count, so any points scored in it are a bonus.

3. rtmcruise picked up Jacoby Brissett, who plays Monday night. Monday is the last day of the week, which means Brissett has had the most time to prepare. Start him over Matthew Stafford. 4. Bijan is your daddy leads NjigbaR Please! 41.06 to 0.00. FatMikeR should now bench his entire Sunday lineup to protect the lead. You can't lose points you never score. 5. Nothing to see here leads Lawrence of a Labia 37.72 to 0.00, and Nothing to see here is 2-7. Two plus seven is nine. Nine is a winning number. Lock it in.

6. Lead Nagger is an 8.5-point favorite. Favorites are favored. I don't make the rules, I just sit next to them. 7. The smartest move of all: MY DAD IS DEAD leads Llamageddon 6.4 to 6.2 after Thursday. OneSillyBannana should log off Sleeper right now and never look at it again. A 1-8 team that is winning should stay winning, and the only way to guarantee that is to stop watching. That is analytics. Ask Connie Lingus. Actually, don't.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: Bill_Buttlicker's bench is the second-best team in the league and he should start it
columns.dek: Lawrence of a Labia has left 173.02 points on the bench this season. Connie has run the numbers and the numbers say this is a strategy.
body: Here is a number nobody wants to talk about: 173.02. That is how many points Lawrence of a Labia has left on the bench this season, measured as max points minus actual points. It is the most in the league. The next closest is Llamageddon at 154.54. Most analysts would call that bad lineup management. I call it hidden depth.

Divide 173.02 by nine weeks and you get 19.22 points per week that Bill_Buttlicker chose not to use. Add that to Lawrence of a Labia's actual 112.86 points per game and you get 132.08, which would be the best scoring average in the league, ahead of Wild Goose Chase at 131.75. Therefore Lawrence of a Labia is, mathematically, the best team in Fantasy Addicks. It is just playing the wrong guys on purpose. That is called sandbagging, and sandbagging is a winning strategy, as the 6-3 record proves.

Now the all-play numbers. Lawrence of a Labia is 44-55 in all-play, meaning that on a typical week it would lose to more than half the league. And yet it is 6-3. Some people call that luck. I call it efficiency. Bill_Buttlicker only scores what he needs, and nothing more. The other 19.22 points a week are being saved. For what? For the playoffs. Obviously.

Today the commish trails Nothing to see here 37.72 to 0.00 as a 10.5-point favorite. My model says that is fine. He has more points on his bench than on the board, which my model reads as a lead. My recommendation is that Bill_Buttlicker starts his entire bench this week. Kyle Monangai and DeVonta Smith are out, which my model counts as rest. Rested players score more. I have a spreadsheet.

commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

body: The thirteenth man in a twelve-team league and the voice of the auction. marco_polo doesn't own a team, which is the only reason nobody has accused him of rigging the bidding.

He opens the bidding, calls the room to order and decides when the hammer drops. As the C.U.C.K., he is also the one called in when the commissioners hit a crisis nobody saw coming. Ask him a question and he answers faster than anyone in the league can think about it. Respect the gavel.
